name: Firewall
description: Restricts the container's outbound and forwarded traffic to an allowlist of presets, domains, and CIDRs (or keeps it from a denylist), applied with nftables and dnsmasq at every start. A guardrail, not a security boundary.

defaultAction.description: What happens to outbound traffic that no allowed or denied entry matches: deny refuses it (allowlist), allow lets it through (denylist).

presets.description: Comma-separated named destination sets to allow: github, npm, pypi, anthropic, vscode. Empty selects none.

allowedDomains.description: Comma-separated domains to allow, each with every subdomain (no wildcards), for example example.com,registry.example.org.

allowedCidrs.description: Comma-separated IPv4 or IPv6 addresses or CIDRs to allow on every port, for example 10.0.0.5,172.18.0.0/16.

deniedDomains.description: Comma-separated domains to refuse, each with every subdomain (no wildcards); the more specific of an allowed and a denied entry decides.

deniedCidrs.description: Comma-separated IPv4 or IPv6 addresses or CIDRs to refuse on every port; the more specific of an allowed and a denied entry decides.

failureMode.description: When the rules cannot be applied in full: closed keeps only loopback and DNS reachable and fails the start check; warn removes the rules and only warns.

filterForward.description: Apply the rules to traffic the container forwards, such as that of nested Docker containers.
